description: Save an email as a DRAFT. This does NOT deliver anything and does NOT count against the plan's monthly send quota. Takes the same arguments as send_email. Returns the draft id and a `draftUrl` that opens the draft in Bottled's web UI, where the user can read it exactly as the recipient will and edit or send it. Use this whenever the user wants to review an email before it goes out; call send_draft once they approve. Re-drafting the same message overwrites the workspace's open draft to that recipient rather than adding a duplicate (`replaced: true` in the result). Pass newDraft: true only when a genuinely separate second email to the same person is wanted.

from.description: Sender address on a verified domain the workspace owns, e.g. hello@yourdomain.com. Resolved to the workspace's primary address at send time when omitted.

newDraft.description: Force a separate draft instead of overwriting the open draft to this recipient. Leave false when revising a message.

name: create_draft
